user_sees: Sheet titled "Edit member" with every saved detail filled in
The saved country code and number (a +971 member opens as +971)
Buttons "Cancel" and "Save changes"
No photo row
must_not: A non-Indian number shown as +91
Empty boxes for details that were saved

steps.action: Change the name and the emergency number, tap "Save changes"
user_sees: Button reads "Saving…"
The sheet closes and the page shows the new name
must_not: The member's photo removed
The member's plan, dues or visits changed
A second member made

steps.action: Clear the name and tap "Save changes"
user_sees: Under Full name: "Type the member’s name."; the box is brought into view
must_not: The member saved with an empty name
The sheet closing

steps.action: Type the mobile number of another member on the list and tap "Save changes"
user_sees: Under Mobile number: "{name} already has this mobile number in Members."
must_not: Two members with one number
The other member's details changed

start: The page of an archived member

user_sees: At the end of the form: "This member is archived. Saving here won’t change that. To bring them back, tap “Restore member” on their page."

steps.action: Fix a typo in the name and tap "Save changes"

must_not: The member back on the list and in the counts
The photo changed

steps.action: Tap "Edit" and change the mobile number, then tap "Save changes"

must_not: A WhatsApp or SMS sent to the old or the new number by the save

The member's app sign-in moved to another person without a check (not read: unknown)
